lead: The ANC and MK Party have agreed in principle to work together in KwaZulu-Natal, with reports of an MK-led bloc taking shape in eThekwini that would leave the DA out. Police are investigating two weekend mass shootings, one near Pietermaritzburg, that left 17 dead, while markets watch the rand near R17/$ ahead of CPI on Wednesday and the SARB on Thursday.

items.title: ANC and MK Party agree in principle to cooperate in KwaZulu-Natal
items.summary: In their first formal meeting since the 2023 split, the two parties reached an in-principle understanding to work together in the province. Terms are not final; MK leads 19 KZN councils including eThekwini, and councils must be constituted within 14 days of results.

items.title: Reported MK-led bloc could govern eThekwini without the DA
items.summary: Party insiders describe a possible MK, ANC, EFF and ActionSA arrangement holding 134 of eThekwini's 223 seats, with a similar bloc in Johannesburg. No agreement has been announced and talks are continuing.

items.title: 17 killed in two mass shootings in Atteridgeville and near Pietermaritzburg
items.summary: Police reported nine deaths in Jeffsville informal settlement near Pretoria and eight in Sweetwaters outside Pietermaritzburg. No arrests have been made; Gauteng police say the Jeffsville attack is linked to last December's Saulsville hostel shooting.

items.title: DA says ActionSA's demand to drop Zille is hard to swallow
items.summary: Herman Mashaba wants the DA to withdraw Helen Zille and Cilliers Brink as mayoral candidates in Johannesburg and Tshwane. DA leader Geordin Hill-Lewis said the party is still weighing it and did not rule out reviewing its role in the GNU.

items.title: Western Cape water allocations cut as dam levels fall
items.summary: Minister Pemmy Majodina announced a 15% cut to irrigation allocations and 7% for domestic and industrial use. Combined storage was 72.5% in early November against 84.4% a year earlier, and mandatory restrictions could follow in 2027.

items.title: Zuma to seek indemnity after ConCourt dismisses R28.9m legal fees appeal
items.summary: The Constitutional Court refused Zuma leave to appeal the order to repay state-funded legal costs, putting his pension at risk of attachment. His foundation says he will claim indemnity from the state and ask the Presidency not to enforce in the meantime.

items.title: Businessman Suliman Carrim denied bail in Musina
items.summary: The court found Carrim a flight risk, citing his UAE residence permit and his earlier failure to appear before the Madlanga commission. He faces money laundering and related charges, and the case moves to the regional court on 23 November.

items.title: Damaging winds forecast for KZN coast today
items.summary: The Weather Service warned of damaging coastal winds in KwaZulu-Natal on Tuesday, with thunderstorms in Gauteng and Limpopo and very hot conditions in parts of the Western and Northern Cape.

items.title: Iran says supertanker sank after hitting mine in Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: The Revolutionary Guards said two tankers struck naval mines on an 'unauthorised' route and one, carrying over 2 million barrels of crude, sank. Iran did not name the vessels and the claim has not been independently confirmed.

items.title: Trump to meet Putin and Xi in China this week
items.summary: The first-ever trilateral meeting of the three leaders is expected to focus on nuclear proliferation and the Iran war, according to US officials.

items.title: Ukraine launches its largest drone attack on Russia
items.summary: Russia reported downing drones over Moscow, Crimea and the Black Sea, and a Kerch Strait bridge was hit. Separately, Estonia will close all border crossings with Russia from 1 December after an alleged sabotage plot.

items.title: UK, Canada, Australia and Italy urge Israel to let winter aid into Gaza
items.summary: The four countries' foreign ministers asked Israel to allow 150,000 tents and essential supplies in, saying flooding from the first winter storm has worsened conditions.

items.title: SA presses rich nations for trillions in climate finance at COP31
items.summary: At talks in Antalya, Turkey, South Africa's delegation is pushing for binding finance commitments from developed countries, including for adaptation and loss and damage.

items.title: South Sudan postpones elections to February 2027
items.summary: The electoral commission moved the presidential and parliamentary vote from 22 December to 11 February, citing registration and logistics. It would be the country's first election since independence in 2011.

items.title: Rand nears R17/$ on US rate bets and coalition worries
items.summary: The rand touched about R16.97-R16.99 on Monday as a firmer dollar weighed on gold and platinum, while investors fretted over signs the DA may be shut out of metro coalitions.

items.title: CPI due Wednesday, SARB rate decision Thursday
items.summary: October inflation is released on 18 November, with Nedbank expecting 5.6%. The repo rate is 7.25% after September's hike; Nedbank leans toward another 25bp increase but says a hold is possible.

items.title: Big December petrol cut on the cards, diesel may rise
items.summary: Mid-month Central Energy Fund data point to petrol 95 falling about R2.73 a litre inland in December, while wholesale diesel could rise slightly as tax relief is reversed.

items.title: Bafana face Kenya in Nairobi tonight after 2-2 draw
items.summary: Kenya equalised in the 90th minute at Orlando Stadium on Friday after Relebohile Mofokeng had restored South Africa's lead. The AFCON 2027 qualifier return leg kicks off at 18:00 SA time at Nyayo Stadium.

items.title: Springboks edged 21-19 by France in Paris
items.summary: France led 21-7 at half-time at the Stade de France before the Boks fought back to within two points. It was only France's second win over South Africa in their last 11 meetings.

items.title: Ackerman century powers Proteas against Bangladesh
items.summary: Marques Ackerman hit 157 and Zubayr Hamza a career-best 83 as South Africa closed day two at 287-4, 113 behind Bangladesh's 400 at the Wanderers. Kagiso Rabada took 5-70.

items.title: ULA's Vulcan rocket fails, losing 40 Amazon Leo satellites
items.summary: Sunday's launch from Cape Canaveral failed to reach orbit after a problem during the upper-stage burn. It is ULA's first total mission failure since 2006 and is expected to ground Vulcan and delay Amazon's internet constellation.

items.title: Ramaphosa pitches SA as Africa's AI hub in Silicon Valley
items.summary: On a week-long US programme, the president argued that SA's power surplus, telecoms and data centres make it a strong AI investment base, and called for homegrown AI firms rather than just hosting infrastructure.
